questions.stem: An 85-year-old man had died of a heart attack caused by severe arteriosclerosis. He was a deaf-mute. Histo pathologic examination of the temporal bones showed degeneration of the stria vascularis, the organ of Corti, and the saccular sensory epithelium with a variable degree of cochlear and vestibular nerve atrophy. The osseous labyrinth, the membranous utricle, and the ampullae of the semicircular canals appeared normal. What would be the anomaly of the inner ear?
